newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends higher on dollar unwinding.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends higher on dollar unwinding.

text.p: The won closed higher against the dollar on Thursday as views that the dollar was overbought prompted dollar unwinding, dealers said.
"High dollar positions were mainly to blame for the dollar's fall," said a domestic bank dealer.
The won closed at 892.40, compared with Wednesday's closing of 893.60. It opened at 893.40 and moved between 892.30 and 893.60.
The won's mid-rate is expected to be pegged at 893.20 on Friday, compared with 893.70 today.
